CODE/experiment_platform/v2_analysis.py:223-276 unconditionally rejects this metric; a read-only synthetic dispatcher probe reproduced the rejection. A newcomer following the supplied commands therefore cannot complete the requested batch analysis even if every formal run succeeds.

COLD-B2 [load-bearing analysis workflow is missing]: brief.json:7,42,49-52 promises production-versus-independent per-link comparisons, a digest-qualified diagnostic decision witness and canonical persisted JSON with SHA256 inventory. tools/step5_recompute.py:27-55,104-228 has no production-reading input/comparator, no formal/diagnostic identity verifier, no decision-log input/count reconciliation, and no file loader/output entry point; neither RUNBOOK invokes it. A cold reader cannot reproduce the promised evidence from the artifacts alone or know which reviewed analysis implementation is frozen.

COLD-B3 [lossy evidence contradicts exhaustive reporting]: brief.json:8,49-50 requires EVERY gap to be individually shown and EVERY mismatch to be individually reported. tools/step5_recompute.py:197,203 emits only the first 20 closure errors and first 50 gap violations, and :132-148 retains no complete per-gap table for successful packets. More than 50 gap violations lose packet/time/length details in the returned report. The stated exact equality is actually an absolute 1e-9-second comparison (:126), but that tolerance is not declared in the request or returned as a gap-check contract. There is no alternate persisted full-detail output in this package.

required_revision: Resolve COLD-B1 before authorization: provide and freeze a supported, executable analysis route for this structural closure contract, with exact commands in the run instructions. Do not silently replace the target metric with a performance metric or change the scientific question. Recompile and re-review any changed bound artifacts.

Resolve COLD-B2 by persisting the complete evidence-consumption workflow: verify formal receipts and external launch witnesses; map ledger fields explicitly; compare the independent and production readings using the same directed-link population, denominator and window semantics; specify zero-capacity/degenerate treatment and fixed tolerances; verify diagnostic code/config/trace/event identities and compute an independent decision-count witness, marking it unavailable on failed equivalence; write canonical per-cell outputs and an input/output SHA256 inventory. Bind the work-specific analysis implementation and contract in the next reviewed artifact set. Document the compile/finalize/authorize/clean-deploy/run/analysis handoffs without prematurely creating finalization.

Resolve COLD-B3 by persisting an untruncated per-packet, per-gap table and all error records (including packet id/start/end/length/expected value), while allowing separately labelled summary previews. Freeze and report the numeric tolerances and aggregate evidence-eligibility rule before viewing formal results. Retain the current honest exclusions and the disclosed minimal corridor acceptance gate.
